rationale: Price made its move toward the take-profit target (MFE of 1.89%, reaching ~$39.55), but the last several candles show a sharp V-shaped recovery back above the 9-EMA ($39.90) and nearly back to entry, with the most recent candle printing $40.21 on elevated volume (5,161) — a clear sign of buying absorption reversing the short momentum.
